column1: # Probes of testdata/boundary that do not give the output of go run yet,
# per mode (vm: default mode, aot: yaegi -aot, restricted: yaegi v2
# -restricted -aot, the mode of Traefik's plugins). TestBoundary fails on any
# other difference, and when a probe listed here gives the output of Go:
# then remove its line. Class: wrong (a silent wrong result), crash (an
# error of the VM, or a panic where Go has none, or none where Go has
# one), message (only the panic value or the text of a message differs).
# restricted (restricted mode only): a difference that the restricted mode
# makes on purpose, with no issue: a program it refuses (an import or a
# function that plugins cannot use), or a state of its own (os.Stdin, the
# default registries of the standard library). The probe "" is the output
# before the first probe (the error of a refused program).
# A mode with a release (vm@go1.27) is for that Go release only.
# The issue column is a short name of the cause, shared by the probes
# with the same cause ("-" when there is no issue).
